name: Classic American Grilled Cheese with Homemade Tomato Soup

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
½ tsp basil, dried
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add flour to the pot and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until onion is well coated, about 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, broth, and tomato paste to the pot, then stir to combine the soup. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat and simmer until thickened slightly, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (411 g) can diced tomatoes
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp tomato paste

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place bread slices on a flat surface. Top half of the slices with two pieces of cheese each. Cover sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 slice white bread
8 slice American cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, spread mayo on the top side of the sandwiches.
Once the skillet is hot, add sandwiches, mayo-side down, and cook until the bottoms are golden, 2-3 minutes.

Remove the sandwiches to a plate, toasted-side down, and spread the other side with additional mayo. Return sandwiches, mayo-side down, to the skillet, and cook until golden on the other side and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
When the soup has thickened slightly, using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pot.)
Return soup to medium heat, add cream, and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
Divide sandwiches between plates and serve with soup on the side. Enjoy!
